source: Hyperliquid BTC, 20 minutes of 100 ms rows with the values computed when src/index-weights.json was fitted
note: Rows are on an exact 100 ms grid (book and asset-context fields forward-filled; buy_sz/sell_sz/trade_count 0 in buckets with no trades). Feed them in order from a fresh state; expected values are given once per second from 11 minutes in (the 600 s windows of flowz/vol_600s need 600 s plus their inner window). micro is computed from bid/ask px/sz. Values are rounded to 7 significant digits, so expect ~1e-4 relative error on OFI sums and ~1e-2 on oi_signed_300s. 49 rows (around ts 1791806693500) carry a book-invalidation state: depth_bid_5 = depth_ask_5 = 0 (imb5 undefined) and mid != (bid+ask)/2. Fields: mid/bid_px/ask_px/bid_sz/ask_sz are Hyperliquid L1; imb1/imb10 are book imbalances over levels 1 and 1-10; depth_bid_5/depth_ask_5 are size sums over levels 1-5; buy_sz/sell_sz/trade_count are taker trades in the bucket; mark/oracle/funding/oi come from activeAssetCtx.
